releases.notes:
## Skyblock QoL 0.1.0 - Holographic 3D Interface

A floating, world-space holographic GUI for Minecraft (Fabric, MC 26.3) - real 3D geometry in the world, not a 2D overlay.

### Highlights
- **Floating holographic panels** rendered as actual world geometry with physical depth, extruded 3D buttons, glowing borders and transparency
- **Crosshair interaction** - aim at a component to hover (with feedback + sound), click, toggle and drag sliders; walking right up to a block still lets you mine through a panel
- **Animations** - smooth open/close with eased scaling, pulsing glow, hover lift effects, sliding toggle knobs and a sweeping scanline
- **Multiple simultaneous panels** - a console that follows you and a world-anchored stats panel you can walk around; panels face the player and render back-to-front
- **Modular architecture** - rendering (`holo/render`) is fully separated from UI logic (`holo/ui`) through a shared draw contract, so new panels/components are easy to add
- **Client-side only** - multiplayer-safe, no packets, compatible with existing Skyblock QoL features (skills, timers, chat rules, HUD)

### Controls
- `H` - Toggle the holographic QoL console (timers, chat-rule switch, opacity/glow settings)
- `O` - Toggle the holographic skill stats panel
- Crosshair + Left click - Interact with buttons, toggles and sliders

### Build fix
- Gradle Wrapper updated to **9.9.2** (Fabric Loom `1.20.0-alpha.31` requires >= 9.9.0); GitHub Actions now builds with Temurin 25 and the wrapper. `./gradlew build` passes.

### Install
Drop `skyblock-qol-0.1.0.jar` into your `mods/` folder (requires Fabric Loader >= 0.19.5 and Fabric API).

readmeSummary: A client-side Fabric mod for Hypixel Skyblock that replaces ordinary mod menus with floating holographic panels rendered as real geometry inside the Minecraft world.
